svg.title: Everyday Agent detailed architecture
svg.desc: Architecture of the local Everyday Agent prototype: browser PWA, dynamic trust engine, policy gate, persistence, optional local API, simulation lab, and blocked external side effects.
svg.text: Local pre-launch prototype · trust-first decisioning · external side effects disabled
Family: owner · partner · teen · trusted person
Human approval is separate from model confidence.
HTML, CSS and JavaScript · can run without backend
create task · approve · reject · defer · explain · undo / redo concept
UI actions are inputs to policy; they are not external execution by themselves.
everyday_agent.py · trust is a signal, never a permission
hard caps · consent expiry · manual mode
fast approval +12 · slow approval +1 to +6 · rejection -30 · execution error -40
profile-specific decay toward baseline · imported trust is discounted and never Level 1
audit event + KPI update + only the relevant trust profile changes
Local by default · retention and export/deletion controls are explicit
Prototype note: local hash chaining is tamper-evident, not a qualified immutable/WORM audit system.
daily log · trust profiles · notifications avoided
Evidence for design review, not a production safety certification.
No real user, provider or external system is contacted.
Future only: least privilege, idempotency, confirmation binding, monitoring and kill switch.
